title: Supervised evidence-gated entity and relation extraction with out-of-fold evaluation
rationale: The original zero-shot experiment completed but failed its absolute F1 gates. E27v2 tests whether expert labels can support a supervised extractor while preserving evidence grounding and ontology-valid relations.
integrity_statement: The original frozen result remains unchanged. E27v2 is a separately identified analysis and must not be presented as the preregistered E27 test result.

dataset.leakage_control: Each record is scored only in a fold whose models were trained on the other four folds. Fold assignment uses source_group only and does not inspect text or labels.

model.entity_head: BIO token classification over nine ontology entity types
model.relation_head: ontology-masked ordered-pair sequence classification over nine relation types plus NONE
model.evidence_gate: Every predicted entity must be an exact source span and every relation must link two predicted spans with a valid domain-range signature.

superseded_reason: The absolute 0.80 and 0.65 values were found not to be part of the original frozen E27 protocol. The formal recovery protocol is v2.1 and restores superiority over the strongest frozen baseline as the primary success criterion.
